scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The proof is symbolic from endpoint and applicability definitions; no numerical experiment is promoted to a universal proof.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limitations: No claim is made for nonlinear perturbations, other schemes, or enlarged induction procedures.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Exact classification for one positive linear rotational IRE scheme and the elementary moves permitted in the motivating construction.
